description: The corpus's MEASURED crossing-count model mu(A) = 5A - 1 (CrossingCountAffine, 12 nuclei to A=39) breaks the b3=0 pair-local locus that the Hopf/Borromean carriers sat on, so it passes CountChannelCarrierLocus's acceptance test -- and then gives b3/b2 = -13/9, the wrong sign against a measured +0.6411239316. For any affine mu the ratio depends only on r = intercept/slope; the b3>0 window is r in (-2, -1.5), the measured model has r = -0.2, and the required value is -1.6214. The gap is one ratio, off by 8.11x, not the functional form.
q0_pin: not applicable -- consumes no framework q-dependent quantity

assertions.name: the measured model BREAKS the b3=0 locus (mu_t != 3*mu_p), so it passes CountChannelCarrierLocus's acceptance test
but its b3 has the WRONG SIGN against the measured b3/b2 > 0
b3/b2 depends only on the intercept-to-slope ratio r = b/a (checked by rescaling the slope with r held fixed)
the measured r = -0.2 lies OUTSIDE the b3>0 window (-2, -1.5)
the required r is inside that window, so the affine family is not excluded -- only this intercept is

scope: (a) on the conjunction {affine count multiplicity, the measured (5, -1)}. It excludes neither the count channel nor affine models in general -- the required r sits inside the window, so an affine carrier CAN work. What is measured is that the corpus's own crossing counts miss the required intercept ratio by 8.11x.
caveats: b4 is NOT reproduced either (model 17/9 = 1.889 vs measured 4.155), and fixing r to match b3 does not free a second parameter to match b4 -- an affine mu has only one ratio. So matching b3 alone would leave b4 as an independent test, which is the honest way to use this: r is determined by b3, then b4 is a prediction.

mu(A) = 5A - 1 is charge-free, so it cannot distinguish 3H from 3He. That is consistent with using the isospin-averaged Bbar(3) here, but it also means the model has nothing to say about the mirror splitting.
The 12-nucleus fit behind (5, -1) is the sibling's measurement, not re-derived here. If those counts are revised the verdict moves, and this probe should be re-run rather than quoted.
